inputs.original_text: A MASSIVE anti-Trump protest descended into chaos after crowds packed the streets and federal officers moved in with tear gas and arrests. What started as a huge “No Kings” rally later turned volatile as agitators squared off with authorities and police ordered people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and...
inputs.modified_text: The “No Kings” rally against Trump shows what happens when political theatrics are allowed to crowd out respect for the law. Streets are not a stage for agitators to confront authorities, and slogans do not excuse disorder. Federal officers used tear gas and made arrests; at least 13 were confirmed in Portland and Denver. A decent society depends on clear rules and the courage to enforce them—not on treating chaos as ordinary political expression.
